description: This file defines the Download model class for the OpenCart admin module, handling database operations related to downloads such as add, edit, delete, retrieve, and manage descriptions and reports.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Model class for managing download records within the Opencart admin module, including CRUD operations, description management, and report handling.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Creates a new download record in the database and adds descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editDownload
methods.description: Updates an existing download record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteDownload
methods.description: Deletes a download record and associated descriptions, reports, and links to products.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific download by its ID.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Fetches a list of downloads based on filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns the total number of download records matching certain filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a download in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a given download ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for downloads in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific download.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all download descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves usage reports (like IP addresses and timestamps) for a download.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes report records for a specific download.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Counts the total number of report entries linked to a specific download.
